verdict.rationale: Jeeves Cash offers yield of up to 5% on multi-currency business account balances, which covers the high-yield part of the story. Converting funds between Jeeves Cash accounts appears to be manual, and scheduled payments are framed around paying vendors, not internal transfers. Missing for 10: a dedicated savings/reserve sub-account for a cash cushion, automated or rule-based transfer/sweep rules into it, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the yield product.
